tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Embedding of the exponential map on the remaining set] The exponential map embeds $S_{X'_J}(B)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch An intersection of radials based in $X'_J$ would form a focusing triangle whose earliest left endpoint lies before, between, or after the selected maximal bases. Each case contradicts the defining maximal selection.

□

Lemma
[No Dx spans between two points of c0]
